summary: End-to-end ML platforms handle the full lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which is more than you need if you are simply calling a hosted model API (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) for inference. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, manage many experiments and model versions, require governance/reproducibility, or serve models under your own infrastructure and compliance constraints. In 2026 the market has consolidated around cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI/Gemini Enterprise, Azure ML) and the lakehouse-centric Databricks, with specialized AutoML and MLOps tools filling adjacent niches.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage (instance-hours, endpoint hours, processing jobs); no upfront fee.
platforms.best_for: Teams standardized on AWS needing AWS-native infrastructure, security, and the broadest enterprise reach; engineering-team-led purchases.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go on Azure compute/storage; no platform surcharge, billed by underlying resources.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing tight integration with Azure OpenAI, governance, and responsible AI.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node-hour, training, prediction, and API usage.
platforms.best_for: Organizations on Google Cloud wanting highly automated, state-of-the-art ML plus Gemini foundation models; note Vertex AI is being folded into Gemini Enterprise as of mid-2026.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs on top of chosen cloud compute; commit/enterprise tiers available.
platforms.best_for: Data-team-led purchases needing unified data, analytics, ML, and AI governance with multi-cloud flexibility.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; managed versions billed via Databricks or hosting provider.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model registry across any stack.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-user/usage-based paid plans; enterprise self-hosted.
platforms.best_for: ML and deep-learning research teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on existing training infra.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; cost is self-managed Kubernetes infrastructure.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting a portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps stack without vendor lock-in.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and analysts wanting automated end-to-end predictive modeling with governance and minimal hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud.
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable AI with on-prem/hybrid options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; generous free credits.
platforms.best_for: Developer and startup teams wanting serverless GPU infrastructure for fine-tuning and inference without managing clusters.

platforms.name: Metaflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; managed via Outerbounds subscription.
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting human-friendly, Python-first pipeline orchestration that scales from laptop to cloud.
